source: Labour Bureau, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India — CPI for Industrial Workers (CPI-IW), September 2026, base 2016=100.
notes: CPI-IW covers industrial-worker households and is used as a published proxy for city-level price levels. It is not a general all-resident cost-of-living index. MoSPI's current CPI release publishes all-India, rural, urban and state/UT indices, not city-level figures, so no MoSPI city index is substituted. Labour Bureau home page: https://labourbureau.gov.in/en
